name: Aariz cephalometric benchmark (Khalid, Fraz 2023) and the ISBI 2015 cephalograms
what: 1,000 lateral cephalograms from 7 devices with 29 landmarks and a cervical vertebral maturation (CVM) stage per film, C2 to C4 in every image (arXiv:2302.07797; the CEPHA29 challenge at ISBI 2023); the ISBI 2015 set of 400 cephalograms with 19 landmarks and no CVM stage is openly downloadable
level_truth: C2 to C4 by the CVM stage (named vertebra shapes); no other level
status: on the volume at the census of 2026-10-22 (1,000 images with their sidecars, docs/research/data-manifest/MANIFEST.md); found by the sweep of 2026-10-21; not fetched; the 1,000-film set is an open figshare download (27986417, one zip of 2,098,209,792 bytes), entered in grid/fetch-xray.json as aariz on 2026-10-21 (issue #40); the 400-film ISBI 2015 set's link is still to confirm; pediatric anchors for the top of the cervical counter from seven devices
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the figshare record's licence field, read from the API on 2026-10-21)
how_to_get: The 1,000-film set is figshare article 27986417 (doi 10.6084/m9.figshare.27986417), one file Aariz.zip with its md5 in the record; the paper is Khalid, Fraz et al., Scientific Data 12, 1336 (2025), doi 10.1038/s41597-025-05542-3.

Fetch it as a Slurm job on the owner's word, never on the login node: bash grid/run-xray-chain.sh --only aariz, whose stage 1 reads the API, runs http-get with the md5 and unpacks the zip (grid/README.md).
The ISBI 2015 set of 400 cephalograms is the entry isbi2015_cephalograms of grid/fetch-xray.json, whose link is still to confirm.
